metadata.title: fix: auth hardening consistency updates for RC2 (h-batch-1)
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary: H-Batch-1

This PR resolves the following hardening items for RC2:

- C-38: `/health/security` now requires a properly parsed Bearer token and validates the JWT, rather than accepting header format alone.
- C-30: JSON-RPC `logging/setLevel` now enforces `admin.system_config` before applying log-level changes.
- C-13: Utility transport permission alignment on `/sse` and `/message` now uses `tools.execute`.
- C-33: `require_auth` now enforces shared token/account validity checks (revocation + active-user).
- C-16: `require_admin_auth` now applies the same shared token/account validity checks before admin authorization.

## Docs and Changelog
- RC2 changelog/docs entries were updated to reflect these changes with hardening/consistency framing.
